q: Run A scores 48% and Run B 67% on the same benchmark with the same model. What should you check first?
options: Whether harness version, prompt template, attempts and budget match
explain: Configurations that differ make scores incomparable.

q: In Inspect, what three things does a Task combine?
explain: Task(dataset=..., solver=..., scorer=...) is the core structure.

q: What should an eval harness store besides scores?
options: Every sample’s full trace and the configuration that produced it
explain: Traces make scores debuggable; configs make them reproducible.
